notes.title: Seaside Version
notes.notes:
Dear friends, I'm Neo.

After months of intense work, I've just officially updated the seaside content. Now the seaside area is open, and you can get there via the road on the right side of the town.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/9c675429c63b389fe87701caa09f97770bfa5274.png


Meanwhile, the fishing gameplay has been implemented. You can unlock it by triggering the plot when you go to the seaside.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/26232415b2537c8ecc35adf8b7e5b42c075fc3a5.png


In this version, over 30 unique and completely different fish species have been added. They can be collected from different water areas, at different times, and in different seasons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/502f82c7d596a6876c884050568c5d8d05af61ac.png


I've created 11 new collectibles, each with its unique function.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101618/f4a275a22a72921136596250454393af44335f93.png


I must apologize to all players. The aquarium update originally scheduled for the end of this month has to be postponed for a while.

The gameplay I originally designed was that various aquatic products caught could be placed in the fish tanks of the aquarium, thus increasing the aquarium's attractiveness. Then, the aquarium would generate income from tourists' visits every day.

However, the frame animation of the waves has consumed too much time. Also, due to some force majeure, my landlord took back his house, and it took me several days to find a new place, which also cost some time.

But I will work hard on the aquarium content in the coming month. It includes more than ten types of fish tanks and many unique aquarium walls, floors, etc.

In the next month, I will update the following content in chronological order:
Fish - related cuisine
Ways to obtain the complete fish atlas
Quests from the seaside fishermen
Aquarium
Seaside salt - making field
More fish species
Expansion of newbie guidance quests and villager quests

After completing these, I will start working on the Seaview Restaurant (supply chain) and Seaview Dessert Shop (supply chain). There are expected to be about 5 - 6 buildings and their supporting supply chains by the seaside. Each building will take about 14 - 21 days to make.

After finishing most of the seaside content, I will start working on the protagonist's dressing - up function and support for more skin colors and hair colors.

I'm really grateful to so many players for their support. I will keep working hard to create more game content and thank you all for your patience!
